name: hero_attribute
definition: 记录某位英雄在某一属性维度上取值的登记条目，属于信息记录。 Counterexample: 易与英雄本身混淆；本对象是属性取值记录，不是英雄实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table hero_attribute; provenance: direct source hero_attribute

name: attribute
definition: 描述可被赋予英雄的度量维度的目录条目，属于信息记录。 Counterexample: 易与具体属性取值混淆；本对象是维度定义，不含具体数值。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table attribute; provenance: direct source attribute

name: hero_power
definition: 记录某位英雄具备某项能力的关联条目，属于信息记录。 Counterexample: 易与能力本身混淆；本对象是英雄与能力之间的关联记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table hero_power; provenance: direct source hero_power

name: account
definition: 由金融机构开立、归属于某一地区并具有对账单频率与开户日期的资金存放实体。 Counterexample: 易与客户混淆；账户是资金载体，客户是持有主体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table account; provenance: direct source account

name: district
definition: 按行政区划划分、以编号标识并带有若干统计属性列的地理区域实体。 Counterexample: 易与账户混淆；地区是地理区域，账户是资金载体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table district; provenance: direct source district

name: client
definition: 在金融机构登记、具有性别与出生日期并归属某一地区的主体。 Counterexample: 易与账户混淆；客户是主体，账户是其所持资金载体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table client; provenance: direct source client

name: disp
definition: 记录某客户对某账户具有某种支配方式的关联条目，属于信息记录。 Counterexample: 易与账户本身混淆；本对象是客户与账户之间的支配关系记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table disp; provenance: direct source disp

name: card
definition: 由账户支配关系签发、具有卡类型与签发日期的支付凭证实体。 Counterexample: 易与账户混淆；卡是支付凭证，账户是资金载体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table card; provenance: direct source card

name: loan
definition: 由账户发放、具有金额、期限、还款额与状态的资金借贷实体。 Counterexample: 易与账户混淆；贷款是借贷合约，账户是资金载体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table loan; provenance: direct source loan

name: order
definition: 记录从某账户向指定银行与账号划转金额的指令条目，属于信息记录。 Counterexample: 易与贷款混淆；本对象是资金划转指令，不是借贷合约。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table order; provenance: direct source order

name: molecule
definition: 以编号标识并具有标签名称的化学微粒实体。 Counterexample: 易与原子混淆；分子由原子构成，原子是更小的组成单元。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table molecule; provenance: direct source molecule

name: atom
definition: 属于某一分子、以元素种类标识的化学微粒实体。 Counterexample: 易与分子混淆；原子是分子的组成单元。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table atom; provenance: direct source atom

name: bond
definition: 存在于某一分子内、具有键类型的原子间连接实体。 Counterexample: 易与原子混淆；键是原子间的连接，不是微粒本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table bond; provenance: direct source bond

name: connected
definition: 记录两个原子通过某化学键相连的关联条目，属于信息记录。 Counterexample: 易与化学键混淆；本对象是连接记录，键是连接实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table connected; provenance: direct source connected

name: alignment
definition: 记录某一对齐取值的条目，属于信息记录。 Counterexample: 易与分子混淆；本对象是对齐信息，不是化学实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table alignment; provenance: direct source alignment

name: colour
definition: 以编号标识的颜色取值目录条目，属于信息记录。 Counterexample: 易与属性混淆；本对象是颜色取值，不是度量维度。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table colour; provenance: direct source colour

name: gender
definition: 以编号标识的性别取值目录条目，属于信息记录。 Counterexample: 易与客户混淆；本对象是取值目录，不是主体。 Maturity: Provisional

name: qualifying
definition: 一场比赛内由车手驾驶赛车完成的计时排位活动记录，以分段最快圈速与最终名次为区别特征 Counterexample: 与正赛结果(results)不同：排位赛只决定发车顺序，不产生积分 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table qualifying; provenance: direct source qualifying

name: results
definition: 比赛结果 Counterexample: 与排位赛成绩(qualifying)不同：后者只决定发车格位，不授予积分 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table results; provenance: direct source results

name: rulings
definition: 由赛事管理机构发布的书面判定记录，以发布日期与正文内容为区别特征 Counterexample: 与比赛结果(results)不同：裁决是信息性判定文本，不是比赛成绩数据 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table rulings; provenance: direct source rulings

name: satscores
definition: 按学校汇总的标准化考试成绩统计记录，以参考人数与各科平均分为区别特征 Counterexample: 与学校(schools)不同：后者是办学机构实体，前者是该机构的成绩汇总信息 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table satscores; provenance: direct source satscores
aliases: 学校学业水平考试成绩

name: schools
definition: 依法设立并具有唯一代码与办学地址的教育机构，以代码、所属学区与开办关闭日期为区别特征 Counterexample: 与学区(district)不同：学区是行政管理划分，学校是其下属办学单位 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table schools; provenance: direct source schools

name: seasons
definition: 以年度为标识的赛事周期记录，以年份与对应链接为区别特征 Counterexample: 与比赛(races)不同：赛季是年度周期，比赛是周期内的单场赛事 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table seasons; provenance: direct source seasons

name: sets
definition: 卡牌游戏中按发行批次组织的卡牌集合目录条目，以代码、名称与发行日期为区别特征 Counterexample: 与卡牌(cards)不同：系列是发行批次目录，卡牌是其中的具体单卡 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table sets; provenance: direct source sets

name: set_translations
definition: 针对某一发行系列代码的多语言名称对照记录，以语言与译名为区别特征 Counterexample: 与卡牌系列(sets)不同：后者是系列本体，前者是系列名称的语言对照信息 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table set_translations; provenance: direct source set_translations

name: status
definition: 用于描述车手完赛情况的状态码目录条目，以状态标识与状态描述为区别特征 Counterexample: 与比赛结果(results)不同：状态是码表目录，结果是被分类的赛事记录 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table status; provenance: direct source status

name: superhero
definition: 由出版机构创作的虚构人物角色，以代号、外貌属性与所属出版方为区别特征 Counterexample: 与出版方(publisher)不同：出版方是创作机构，超级英雄是其笔下角色 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table superhero; provenance: direct source superhero

name: superpower
definition: 对虚构角色所具备特殊能力的命名条目，以能力名称为区别特征 Counterexample: 与英雄能力关联(hero_power)不同：后者是角色与能力的关联记录，前者是能力目录本身 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table superpower; provenance: direct source superpower

name: trans
definition: 银行交易流水 Counterexample: 与转账指令(order)不同：指令是待执行的委托，流水是已发生的资金变动 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table trans; provenance: direct source trans

name: transactions_1k
definition: 加油站零售交易 Counterexample: 与银行交易流水(trans)不同：后者是账户资金变动，前者是零售消费小票级记录 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table transactions_1k; provenance: direct source transactions_1k

name: yearmonth
definition: 按客户与月份聚合的消费金额统计记录，以客户标识、月份与消费额为区别特征 Counterexample: 与加油站零售交易(transactions_1k)不同：后者是逐笔明细，前者是月度汇总 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table yearmonth; provenance: direct source yearmonth

name: zip_code
definition: 邮政编码与所属城市、县、州的对照目录条目，以邮编与行政区划为区别特征 Counterexample: 与地区(district)不同：邮编是邮政分区编码，地区是行政或业务划分 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table zip_code; provenance: direct source zip_code

name: SchoolEnrollmentK12
definition: Number of students enrolled in grades K-12 at a school.

name: FreeMealCountK12
definition: Number of students eligible for free meals in grades K-12.

name: FRPMCountK12
definition: Number of students eligible for free or reduced price meals in grades K-12.
aliases: free or reduced price meal count

name: SchoolType
definition: Classification of the school (e.g., Elementary, Middle, High, Unified).

name: EducationalOptionType
definition: Type of educational program offered by the school (e.g., magnet, charter).

name: CharterSchoolFlag
definition: Indicates whether the school is a charter school (Y/N).

name: LowGrade
definition: Lowest grade level offered by the school.

name: HighGrade
definition: Highest grade level offered by the school.

name: CountyName
definition: County where the school is located.

name: CardName
definition: Name of the Magic: The Gathering card.

name: CardLanguage
definition: Language of the card or set.

name: CardRarity

name: CardFormat

name: CardLegalityStatus
definition: Legality status of the card in a format (e.g., legal, banned).

name: HasContentWarning

name: EDHRank

name: IsStorySpotlight

name: BorderColor
definition: Border color of the card (e.g., white, black).

name: ConvertedManaCost
definition: Converted mana cost of the card.

name: Power
definition: Power value of the card (NULL or '*' if not applicable).

name: CardType
definition: Type line of the card (e.g., Summon - Angel).

name: CardText
definition: Text or flavor text of the card.

name: GasConsumption
definition: Amount of gas consumed by a customer in a month.

name: YearMonth
definition: Year and month of consumption (format YYYYMM).

name: GasStationChain
definition: Chain to which the gas station belongs.

name: GasStationCountry
definition: Country where the gas station is located.

name: LoanDate
definition: Date when the loan was approved.

name: LoanStatus
definition: Status of the loan (e.g., A, B, C, D).

name: AccountFrequency
definition: Frequency of account statements (e.g., POPLATEK TYDNE, POPLATEK PO OBRATU).

name: CardIssuedDate
definition: Date when the card was issued.

scope: lapTimes where time IS NOT NULL

name: Department
aliases: School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education

name: IncomeAmount
definition: Amount of income received by a member

name: HeroAttributeValue
definition: Numeric value of a hero attribute

name: LabDate
definition: Date the laboratory test was performed

name: AdmissionType
definition: Whether the patient was admitted (+) or outpatient (-)

name: MoleculeLabel
definition: Carcinogenicity label of a molecule (+ carcinogenic, - non-carcinogenic)

name: Element
definition: Chemical element symbol of an atom

name: BondType
definition: Type of chemical bond (- single, # triple)

name: EligibleFreeRateK12
definition: Proportion of K-12 students eligible for free meals. Formula: FreeMealCountK12 / SchoolEnrollmentK12. Inputs: FreeMealCountK12 = frpm.Free Meal Count (K-12); SchoolEnrollmentK12 = frpm.Enrollment (K-12)

name: EligibleFRPMRateK12
definition: Proportion of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced price meals. Formula: FRPMCountK12 / SchoolEnrollmentK12. Inputs: FRPMCountK12 = frpm.FRPM Count (K-12); SchoolEnrollmentK12 = frpm.Enrollment (K-12)

name: PercentageCommanderLegalNoWarning
definition: Percentage of commander-legal cards that do not have a content warning. Formula: COUNT(HasContentWarning = 0) / COUNT(CardName) * 100. Inputs: HasContentWarning = cards.hasContentWarning; CardName = cards.name; CardFormat = legalities.format; CardLegalityStatus = legalities.status
aliases: percentage of commander legal cards without content warning

name: PercentageFrenchStorySpotlight
definition: Percentage of story spotlight cards that are in French. Formula: COUNT(CardLanguage = 'French' AND IsStorySpotlight = 1) / COUNT(IsStorySpotlight = 1) * 100. Inputs: CardLanguage = foreign_data.language; IsStorySpotlight = cards.isStorySpotlight
aliases: percentage of French story spotlight cards

name: PercentageFrenchNoPower
definition: Percentage of cards without power that are in French. Formula: COUNT(CardLanguage = 'French' AND (Power IS NULL OR Power = '*')) / COUNT(Power IS NULL OR Power = '*') * 100. Inputs: CardLanguage = foreign_data.language; Power = cards.power
aliases: percentage of French cards without power

name: AnnualAverageConsumption
definition: Average monthly gas consumption over a year. Formula: SUM(GasConsumption) / 12. Inputs: GasConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption

name: ConsumptionGrowth
definition: Change in consumption between two years. Formula: GasConsumption_2013 - GasConsumption_2012. Inputs: GasConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption

name: ConsumptionGrowthPercentage
definition: Percentage change in consumption between two years. Formula: (GasConsumption_2013 - GasConsumption_2012) / GasConsumption_2013 * 100. Inputs: GasConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption

name: LowestConsumptionCustomerAnnualAvg
definition: Annual average consumption for the customer with the minimum total consumption in a segment. Formula: SUM(GasConsumption) / 12 for customer with MIN(SUM(GasConsumption)). Inputs: GasConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption; CustomerSegment = customers.Segment
aliases: annual average consumption of customer with lowest consumpti

name: LoanRunningPercentage
definition: 贷款状态为C(正常)的账户占比 Formula: COUNT(LoanStatus='C') / COUNT(LoanStatus) * 100. Inputs: LoanStatus = loan.status

name: FemaleAccountPercentage
definition: 某地区开户客户中女性占比 Formula: COUNT(ClientGender='F') / COUNT(ClientGender) * 100. Inputs: ClientGender = client.gender

name: GermanRacePercentage
definition: 欧洲大奖赛中在德国举办的比例 Formula: COUNT(CircuitCountry='Germany' AND RaceName='European Grand Prix') / COUNT(RaceName='European Grand Prix') * 100. Inputs: CircuitCountry = circuits.country; RaceName = races.name
aliases: percentage of races hosted in Germany

name: RaceCompletionRate
definition: 车手完成比赛的比例 Formula: COUNT(RaceCompletion) / COUNT(Driver) * 100. Inputs: RaceCompletion = lapTimes.time WHERE time IS NOT NULL; Driver = drivers.driverId

name: AverageLapTime
definition: 某车手某场比赛的平均圈速 Formula: AVG(LapTime). Inputs: LapTime = lapTimes.milliseconds

name: BudgetSpentDifference
definition: 两年活动支出总额之差 Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost WHERE YEAR(EventDate)=2019) - SUM(ExpenseCost WHERE YEAR(EventDate)=2020). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost; EventDate = event.event_date

name: TotalExpense
definition: 某日/某活动的支出总额 Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost

name: TotalBudget
definition: 某活动的预算总额 Formula: SUM(BudgetAmount). Inputs: BudgetAmount = budget.amount

name: DriverWinCount
definition: 车手获胜总次数 Formula: SUM(DriverWins). Inputs: DriverWins = driverStandings.wins

name: YoungestDriver
definition: 出生日期最晚(最年轻)的车手 Formula: MAX(DriverBirthDate). Inputs: DriverBirthDate = drivers.dob

name: OldestDriver
definition: 出生日期最早(最年长)的车手 Formula: MIN(DriverBirthDate). Inputs: DriverBirthDate = drivers.dob

name: MediumShirtAmount50Percentage
definition: Percentage of medium-shirt members who received amount 50 Formula: COUNT(IncomeAmount = 50 WHERE MemberTShirtSize = 'Medium' AND MemberPosition = 'Student_Club') / COUNT(MemberFullName) * 100. Inputs: IncomeAmount = income.amount; MemberTShirtSize = member.t_shirt_size; MemberPosition = member.position; MemberFullName = member.first_name
aliases: percentage of amount 50 received by Student_Club

name: PublisherHeroCountDifference
definition: Difference in number of superheroes between DC Comics and Marvel Comics Formula: COUNT(PublisherName = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(PublisherName = 'Marvel Comics'). Inputs: PublisherName = publisher.publisher_name

name: PatientAge
definition: Age of the patient computed from birthday Formula: YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - YEAR(PatientBirthday). Inputs: PatientBirthday = Patient.Birthday

name: AbnormalIGMPercentage
definition: Threshold of IgM 20% higher than average Formula: AVG(LabIGM) * 1.2. Inputs: LabIGM = Laboratory.IGM

name: MostCommonDiagnosis
definition: Diagnosis with the highest count among a patient subset Formula: MAX(COUNT(PatientDiagnosis)). Inputs: PatientDiagnosis = Patient.Diagnosis

name: EyeColourPopularity
definition: Ranking of eye colours by hero count Formula: COUNT(EyeColour) ORDER BY COUNT DESC. Inputs: EyeColour = colour.colour

name: CarcinogenicMoleculePct
definition: Share of molecules labeled carcinogenic Formula: COUNT(molecule_id where label='+') / COUNT(molecule_id). Inputs: MoleculeLabel = molecule.label; MoleculeCount = molecule.molecule_id

name: CarcinogenicSingleBondPct
definition: Share of single bonds belonging to carcinogenic molecules Formula: COUNT(bond_id where bond_type='-' AND label='+') / COUNT(bond_id where bond_type='-'). Inputs: BondType = bond.bond_type; MoleculeLabel = molecule.label; BondCount = bond.bond_id

name: HydrogenRatioInMolecule
definition: Share of atoms in a molecule that are hydrogen Formula: COUNT(atom_id where element='h') / COUNT(atom_id). Inputs: Element = atom.element; AtomCount = atom.atom_id

name: ChlorinePctInCarcinogenic
definition: Share of atoms in carcinogenic molecules that are chlorine Formula: COUNT(atom_id where element='cl' AND label='+') / COUNT(atom_id where label='+'). Inputs: Element = atom.element; MoleculeLabel = molecule.label; AtomCount = atom.atom_id
aliases: percentage of chlorine in carcinogenic molecules

name: FluorineFreeCarcinogenicPct
definition: Share of carcinogenic molecules that contain no fluorine atom Formula: (COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id where label='+') - COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id where label='+' AND element='f')) / COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id where label='+'). Inputs: MoleculeLabel = molecule.label; Element = atom.element; MoleculeCount = molecule.molecule_id

name: AvgBondsPerIodineAtom
definition: Average number of bonds attached to atoms of element iodine Formula: COUNT(bond_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT atom_id where element='i'). Inputs: Element = atom.element; BondCount = bond.bond_id; AtomCount = atom.atom_id
aliases: average number of bonds per iodine atom
